glosses: to catch

examples.text: Chlorofyl is de groene bladkleurstof van planten die zich in chloroplasten bevindt en met behulp waarvan zij licht opvangen en de energie daarvan omzetten in chemische energie die wordt gebruikt voor fotosynthese.
examples.translation: Chlorophyll is the green dye of plant leaves that is found in chloroplasts and with the help of which they catch light whose energy they convert into chemical energy that is used for photosynthesis.
examples.english: Chlorophyll is the green dye of plant leaves that is found in chloroplasts and with the help of which they catch light whose energy they convert into chemical energy that is used for photosynthesis.
